title: Wild Police Chase Of Stolen Semi-Truck Ends In Crash
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Cobb County, Georgia — On June 24, 2025, Cobb County Police responded to 911 calls about a bobtail semi truck driving recklessly and nearly crashing into other vehicles. An officer spotted the truck on Dallas Highway and attempted a traffic stop, but the driver decided to flee onto both northbound and southbound lanes of Barrett Parkway, trying to evade officers. Cobb County officers discovered that the truck was also stolen, adding to the list of charges the suspect faces.
